messages.味方の攻撃より先に撃って貫通脆弱・嫉妬脆弱を付け、後続の貫通・嫉妬スキルのダメー: A single-target Envy Pierce E.G.O used before allies attack to inflict Pierce Fragility and Envy Fragility, raising the damage of the Pierce and Envy skills that follow.
messages.脆弱の付与: 的中時に貫通脆弱(解析Ⅲで3)と嫉妬脆弱1を付与する。脆弱は1ター: **Inflicting Fragility**: On hit, inflicts Pierce Fragility (3 at Threadspin Ⅲ) and 1 Envy Fragility. Fragility only lasts for 1 turn, so it must land before allies attack.
messages.呪い(解析Ⅲ): 表面的中時に呪い3を付与する。ターン終了時に、次のターンの攻撃: **Curse (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: Inflicts 3 Curse on Heads Hit. At Turn End, it applies one random effect such as Attack Power Down for the next turn, so you cannot choose the result.
messages.釘と追加ダメージ(解析Ⅳ): 表面的中時に釘3(特殊出血)を付与し、呪いのある対: **Nails and extra damage (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: Inflicts 3 Nails (a special Bleed) on Heads Hit and deals +50% damage to targets with Curse.
messages.高めのマッチ威力: 14~24(解析Ⅲで16~26)と高めで、嫉妬6の資源が賄え: **High Clash Power**: A fairly high 14–24, or 16–26 at Threadspin Ⅲ. If the team can cover 6 Envy, it also works for Clashing.
messages.パッシブ「いたい！」: 自分のマイナス効果1つにつき与ダメージ量+10%(最大5: **Passive — It Hurts!**: +10% damage dealt for each negative effect on herself, up to 50%.
messages.速度の高い人格で先に撃ち、脆弱を付けてから味方の攻撃を通す。: Fire it first with a fast Identity, apply Fragility, and then let allies attack.
messages.後続が貫通中心なら覚醒、嫉妬中心なら侵蝕(貫通脆弱1・嫉妬脆弱1、解析Ⅲで嫉妬脆: Use Awakening if the follow-up attackers mainly use Pierce, and Corrosion if they mainly use Envy. Corrosion inflicts 1 Pierce Fragility and 1 Envy Fragility, or 3 Envy Fragility at Threadspin Ⅲ. Corrosion cannot distinguish friend from foe, and its targets are random, so it can hit allies.
messages.嫉妬6のみが必要資源なので、嫉妬を多く出せる編成と合わせる。: It only requires 6 Envy, so pair it with a team that can produce plenty of Envy.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力と貫通脆弱量が増え、呪いが加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Increases power and Pierce Fragility, and adds Curse.
messages.Ⅳ: 釘の付与と、呪い対象へのダメージ量+50%が加わる。: **Ⅳ**: Adds Nails and +50% damage against Cursed targets.
messages.握る者: S1が嫉妬で資源を出せ、S1・S2・S3が釘を付与するので、解析Ⅳの釘: **[The One Who Grips](persona:0204)**: Her Envy S1 supplies resources, and S1, S2, and S3 all inflict Nails, which fits the Threadspin Ⅳ Nails.
messages.W社2級整理要員: S1と守備が嫉妬で、嫉妬6の資源を集めやすく、パッシブも嫉妬: **[W Corp. L2 Cleanup Agent](persona:0202)**: Her S1 and Defense skill are Envy, making the 6 Envy easy to gather, and her passive also triggers with Envy Owned.
